title: Test the cart (JS)
skill: Give the team's test layout and the cases

good: Create test/cart.test.js for src/cart.js. Use node:test (describe, test) and node:assert/strict. Exactly one describe per function, with these names: describe("addItem()"), describe("removeItem()"), describe("applyCoupon()"), describe("total()"); put each function's tests in its block. Start from an empty cart { items: [], coupon: null }. Cases: addItem the same sku with qty 2 then 3 gives one item with qty 5; addItem with qty 0 throws RangeError; removeItem on a cart with mug and tea removes only mug; applyCoupon(cart, "  save10 ").coupon is "SAVE10"; applyCoupon with "FREE" throws; total of one item at 1005 cents with SAVE10 is 904; total of one item at 300 cents with FIVEOFF is 0. Do not change src/cart.js or test/smoke.test.js. Then run: node --test --test-reporter=tap test/*.test.js
lazy: Add tests for the cart module.
